query: INSERT INTO recommendation_feedback (user_id, series_id, verdict, created_at) SELECT user_id, $1, verdict, created_at FROM recommendation_feedback WHERE series_id = $2 ON CONFLICT (user_id, series_id) DO UPDATE SET verdict = CASE WHEN recommendation_feedback.verdict = 'hide_forever' OR EXCLUDED.verdict = 'hide_forever' THEN 'hide_forever' ELSE EXCLUDED.verdict END
